content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), denied under CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal arrhythmias in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. Given the underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, the note indicates prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential atrial fibrillation or other rhythm disturbances that may increase stroke risk."}
